item.title: Palm Springs Planning Commission grants extension for 60-unit project on North Palm Canyon ⋆ The Palm Springs Post
item.description: Delays tied to reviews by Caltrans, Southern California Edison, and Desert Water Agency prompted the two-year extension request for the Siena Townhomes project.

item.title: Palm Springs fire chief details response to Prescott Preserve blaze, outlines prevention steps ⋆ The Palm Springs Post
item.description: A 3.5-acre fire in February destroyed about 100 palm trees; cause remains under investigation with human origin not ruled out.

item.title: Palm Springs expands towing contractor pool beyond city limits ⋆ The Palm Springs Post
item.description: An amended ordinance allows storage facilities within 10 miles of the city border, a move the city hopes will increase competition and lower tow rates.

item.title: Visit Greater Palm Springs touts $1.9B annual tourism impact in city, plots next decade of growth ⋆ The Palm Springs Post
item.description: Convention bookings hit their highest level since 2018, and a new 10-year strategic plan and push for an indoor amateur sports facility are on the horizon.

item.title: Film producer, community advocate Kim Waltrip to receive next star on Walk of the Stars ⋆ The Palm Springs Post
item.description: Waltrip's 487th star dedication ceremony is scheduled for Friday (April 3) at 275 South Palm Canyon Drive.

item.title: Broader questions about Mills Act impact follow latest historic designation ⋆ The Palm Springs Post
item.description: The Mills Act program provides a property tax rebate to owners of designated historic properties who commit to using the savings for ongoing maintenance or restoration.

item.title: Palm Springs announces two changes to city leadership team ⋆ The Palm Springs Post
item.description: Airport executive director heading to Sacramento as city also welcomes new sustainability director.

item.title: Desert Healthcare District approves $3.5 million in grants, overhauls nonprofit sponsorship program ⋆ The Palm Springs Post
item.description: The District also announced an overhaul of its community sponsorship program, introducing a streamlined application process and two annual deadlines for nonprofits seeking event funding.

item.title: After decades of promises, northern Palm Springs redevelopment plan heading toward a vote ⋆ The Palm Springs Post
item.description: The Tramview Heights Specific Plan would guide development of 510 acres over 20 years, replacing a failed earlier effort.

item.title: Palm Springs moves toward energy efficiency 'reach codes,' pilot program for low-income homeowners ⋆ The Palm Springs Post
item.description: Reach codes allow cities and counties to set energy efficiency standards that go beyond the baseline requirements established by the state.
